dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.role: Murhangeri wa Vumbhoni bya Komishini • DPCI Hawks
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Amukela eka Komishini ya Muvutiso, Sbu. Berth 14 yi paluxe swihundla swa le xibakeni, kutani sweswi ntlawa wa swigevenga wu hi lwa hi vuyimeri bya mavele-vele ni swileriso swa ku miyeta swa State Security."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Lexi chavisaka ngopfu, hi khome xiyimiso xa xihahampfhuka xa King Shaka International. Xihahampfhuka ZS-900—xa munhu hi xiyexe xa Gulfstream—xi chele mafurha eHangar 7 ku humesa Zuko, Ma-Sibi, na Mokoena ku ya eDubai."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Swikombiso swimbirhi leswikulu: Xo sungula, Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed ya le Ridge Penthouses leyi kombaka leswaku hinkwavo vanharhu va na xiphemu eka ntlawa lowu. Xa vumbirhi, Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry ya le ka tanikara ta mati ta le n’walungu."
"Pfula xin’wana xa swikombiso leswi ku paluxa Citrus Estate na King Shaka Hangar 7—kumbe u kuma swimbirhi loko u lava ku va pfalela hinkwavo hi tinsimbi eka tarmac."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Xikombiso xa nawu lexi hlamarisaka, Sbu. Leswi swi boha mavoko ya vachuchisi va Ma-Sibi lava nga ni xiphiqo hi tiawara ta makume mune-nhungu, naswona swi sindzisa mupfuni wa Ridge ku pfula buku ya DIFC."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "U landzele tanikara ta mati ku fika ehenhla ka ntshava, Sbu. Swi hlamarisa ngopfu. Vanhu vo tala va yima loko va fika eka ti-penthouse ta le ribuweni ra le Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Languta eka Packhouse B. Mawolintshi ya Valencia eka conveyor ya le henhla, crystal ya ntsena ya 99% eka mabokisi ya mavunwa ehansi, leyi yaka eka King Shaka Cargo Apron. Naswona u yime exikarhi ka ntshovelo wa mina."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Ku chava? E-e, Sbu—i ku cinca swilo. Komishini ya Muvutiso yi lava xitirhi, kutani Ma-Sibi na Mokoena va karhatekile. Kasi miako leyi hi yi akeke laha yi humesa 20 wa timiliyoni ta Euro hi n’hweti."
"Loko u fika eHangar 7 nimadyambu lawa, u ta va ni hlawulo: hi khomele mfumo lowu nga ta hi siva hi Ravumbirhi, hisa estate na ntlawa wa Bra Bheki, kumbe u teka swikhiya swa xitulu hi wexe."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Vaxavisi va le Gauteng va yimile. U kume ndhawu eka tafula, Sbu. Teka leswi eka sefe ya packhouse—naswona ehleketa kahle u nga si pfumelela Colonel van der Merwe a pfalela vumundzuku hi tinsimbi."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Xigevenga? Hi 25 wa tiphesente ta Sovereign Pearl Holdings eka vault ya le Dubai, va ta ndzi vitana xilaveko xa vuhlayiseki bya matiko ya misava! Suka endleleni ya nosewheel, kumbe u endla xiboho xa wena xo hetelela laha!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Unit 3 na Unit 5 ti ya kwihi?! Suka, Sbu—u hundzule ti-sergeant ta mina ti lwa na mina! Munhu un’wana ni un’wana u ti lwela eka tarmac!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Makumu ya ndlela ya xihahampfhuka, Sbu! Tinjiya ta Gulfstream ti hisa, mpfumelelo wa vadiplomati wu tsaleriwile, naswona ti-pallet jack ti layicha mabokisi yo hetelela eka hold."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "U ponile N2, u ponile Pier 2, naswona u ponile ntlawa wa mina wa ku dlaya. Vulavula leswi u nga na swona u nga si pfala switepisi swa ku khandziya!"
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Tisedan timbirhi ta blue-light ti hi pfalelerile endzhaku ka Umgeni off-ramp. Brigadier Mokoena a nga ambalanga na balaclava. U humile a ambale TRT fatigues ya yena, a languta briefcase ya Sithole, kutani a byela corporal wa yena leswaku a hisa movha."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ndzi relele eka storm drain ndzi khome manila folder ya khale ehansi ka vest ya mina. Loko Sparks eGolden Dragon a nga phatlula foni ya Sithole, rito ra Mokoena ri le ka voice note leyi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Languta—ti-plate ND-449-102 ku ya eka 118. Va hakerise City Hall timiliyoni ta mune-mambirhi wa Rand ku yisa mati yo nwa eKwaMashu hi nkarhi wa dyandza, kambe languta diesel toll tags. A va si tshama va hundzukela ethempini."
"Thankara yin'wana na yin'wana yi chayelele ePier 2 Cold Storage hi 01:30 AM. Va rhwala tikhemikhali ta Zuko Ndlovu ehansi ka mavito ya mati ya masipala."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... makume-ntsevu wa tiphesente Abasanta Maritime, mune-khume wa tiphesente Ma-Sibi's family trust. U swi kotile hakunene, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Yisa leswi eka Colonel van der Merwe eOld Archive Basement—kumbe u hisa Berth 14 hi wexe. Hi ndlela yini na yini, a va nge humi va basile."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.role: Mutsundzuxi wa Vuxisi la Vavaliweke • Mboni ya Nkoka
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "U nga pfuri swipfari swa mafasitere, Sbu. Ma-Golf GTI ya Mokoena lama nga riki na swikombiso ya rhendzeleka eAnton Lembede Street hi minete ya makume mambirhi. A va nga dlayanga Auditor Sithole ntsena eUmgeni weighbridge—a va n'wi rindzerile va ri na port transponders leti a ti ri karhi ti basisiwa."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Hinkwaswo leswi Sithole a feleke swona swi le ndzeni ka Docket #409 na handset leyi phatlukeke. Byela mina leswaku a hi fi eka flat leyi nivusiku lebyi."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Queen Street Taxi Boss • Syndicate Fixer
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, ex-Hawk u nghena eQueen Street loko majaha ya TRT ya Mokoena ma ri karhi ma kambisisa minibhasi yin'wana na yin'wana eWarwick Junction. U na xivindzi, Sbu, ndzi ta ku byela."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "A ku na nchumu lowu hundzaka eCBD handle ka loko vachayeli va mina va wu vona—a hi SAPS Nyalas, naswona a hi tithankara leti ta mati leti tsutsumaka hi nkarhi wa mambirhi ya mixo."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "A wu rivalanga ndlela leyi switarata swi tirhaka ha yona, Sbu. Swi endliwile. Tithree ta Quantums ta mina ti pfalelerile SAPS camera van eMonty Naicker Road. U na nkarhi wa ku hefemula."
"Tekani leswi eka war-chest ya route association. Xava diesel, hakerisa clerk, kumbe u pfuna Nandi. Tiyisisa ntsena leswaku Mokoena u humesa ngati hikwalaho ka ku pfala switarata swa hina."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Yingisela kahle. Tithankara letiya ti na City Hall decals eka tinyangwa, a swi tano? Kambe majaha ya mina lama tirhaka vusiku eUmbilo ma vula leswaku mavhili ma le ku ntswonyeni hikwalaho ka ku tika ka tikhemikhali, naswona swigevenga swa Abasanta swi tshama eka Golf R sedans."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Loko vamanana va hina eKwaMashu va ri karhi va yimela hi swibakete eka swipompi leswi omeke. Councillor Ma-Sibi u xavisa vanhu va ka vona."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Kutani Hawk loyi a nga na mianakanyo yo saseka u hetelele a dyondzile ntsengo wa nyama eThekwini. Teka mali leyi ya ku tekiwa eka locker. Hlayisa audio file yoleyo kule na tafula ra Colonel van der Merwe, naswona kumbexana Zuko u ta ku tshika u hanya ku fikela vhiki leri taka."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Tshika Car 4 na Car 7 eka sector ya Victoria Embankment. U tshame u tiva ku tlanga xichess xa tihofisi, Sbu. Tsakela tiawara ta makume mambirhi na mune leti engetelekeke—a ti nge ku ponisi loko Berth 14 yi pfuleka."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "Durban yi fambisiwa hi nawu, Sbu. Zuko u hlayisa swikepe swi rhulile, Ma-Sibi u hlayisa gezi eCity Hall, naswona Task Force ya mina yi hlayisa ku rhula. Mandla Sithole u anakanye leswaku spreadsheet yi nga yimisa xitimela."
"Nyiketa Nandi emahlweni ka xikarefu xa vusiku hi Siku ra 4, kumbe vavanuna va mina va nge titshegi hi ku gongondza eka nyangwa wa wena wa Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Ehe, ehe. Vona leswi mpfula yi swi hoxeke eka tihofisi ta mina. U hlongoriwile eka Hawks, Sbu—ku nghena laha swi lava munhu loyi a lavaka ku fa kumbe loyi a nga na loya wa mali yo tala."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Constable Nandi u kwihi, naswona briefcase ya municipal auditor yi kwihi?"
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Vatirhi lava nga na vuswikoti a va kumeki eka municipality lowu. Swi lulamile—teka xiyimiso xa telecoms. U ta kuma leswaku xi kongoma eka crane ya Zuko eBerth 14."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Load shedding i khombo, Sbu—handle ka loko u tiva leswaku i breaker yihi leyi u faneleke u yi kokela naswona rini. Loko Stage 6 yi ba Point Waterfront, makhamera ya Transnet ma va ma nga voni nchumu hi tiawara ta mune."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Maxaka ya City Hall a ma tshami eku timeni. Valala va kuma tindlu ta vona ti hlaseriwile emahlweni ka loko maboni ya le mitsutsumweni ma tlhela ma va kona."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "Mandla Sithole a a ri accountant wa vutlhari loyi a nga ri na vuswikoti byo hanya. Wena, hi tlhelo rin'wana, u twisisa leverage."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Leyi i mali ya madzana ya ntlhanu ya Randi ku suka eka discretionary ward fund. Hlayisa vito ra trust ya mina kule na maphepha-hungu, naswona hofisi ya mina yi nga ha swi kota ku fambisa gezi ra Eskom loko u lava ku tima."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "U vile u ri karhi u lavisisa eka Procurement Registry B. Ndzi byele leswaku mufambisi loyi a nga na tingana u lava yini hi swilo swa mati ya xihantla."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "U sungule ku nun'hwisa eka Procurement Registry B. N'wi byele leswaku mufambisi wa milandzu loyi a nga hlongoriwa u lava yini hi swikombiso swa mati ya xihatla."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Yup, Central Precinct a yi na stingray tower leyi khomeke SIM serial ya wena ya khale. Ndzi cince baseband MAC address ya wena leswaku yi fana na municipal parking meter. Nwa!"
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "Sithole a a nga ri accountant ntsena—u veke directional mic endzeni ka Pier 2 Cold Storage. Emahlweni ka loko va ba movha wa yena eka N2, foni ya yena yi hlayise voice note ya tiawara ta mune na container manifest ya MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Tivonela eka Stage 6 blackouts. Handle ka loko u tirhisa diesel generator ya wena, decryption rig ya mina yi ta tima."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Tivonela eka tripwire leyi nga ekusuhi na umbrella stand, Sbu! Stage 4 voltage spikes yi hise ti-oscilloscope ta mina timbirhi, naswona swigevenga swa cyber-crime swa Mokoena swi ri karhi swi hlola xitichi xin'wana na xin'wana xa cell tower exikarhi ka Grey Street na harbour."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "U tisele mina GraphemeOS brick ya Mandla Sithole? Foni yoleyo yi na Abasanta remote-wipe daemon eka baseband chip."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Vona timing ya voltage—hi hundze biometric lock yo sungula handle ka ku tlhava Abasanta wipe daemon. Pass yin'wana eka bench naswona drive leyi i ya wena."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Languta eka channel, Sbu. Swikepe swa makume-ntsevu swi rindzile, swikontinara swa madzana manharhu hi siku, naswona Pretoria yi anakanya leswaku xiphepha lexi sayiniweke hi magistrate xi fambisa harbour leyi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ndzi akile Abasanta Logistics ku suka eka cold-storage shed yin'we. Sweswi u yimile eka catwalk ya mina u khome ledger ya auditor loyi a feke. Xana u tele ku ta tlanga hero, kumbe u tele ku ta twisisa supply na demand?"
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Munhu wa vutlhari. Hawks va ku hakelile switsongo naswona va ku cukumetile eka mahlolwa loko u tshinele ngopfu eka ntiyiso. Teka leswi tanihi xiphemu xa wena xo sungula xa Berth 14. Loko vusiku byi fika, tiyiseka leswaku convoy yoleyo ya famba."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "A swi hlamarisi leswi ntlawa wa Mokoena wu ku hosiweke eka N2. U famba ku fana ni musi wa le rivaleni ra swikepe. Byela Titus leswaku ndzi hoxe varindzi va yena va le rivaleni ra swikepe nimadyambu lawa—loko hi ta ringana, a hi swi endleni hi ku nga tirhisi vanhu lava nga tiviki nchumu."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "City Hall yi yivile bajete ya mati malembe ya khume ndzi nga si thola tanker, Sbu. Ndzi hiriye malori ya vona lama a ma ri hava nchumu. Eka tiko leri, swilo swa mfumo swi va swa loyi a hlayisaka dizili ni ku hakela varindzi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "Mokoena i munhu wa tihanyi, kasi Ma-Sibi i xigwenha. Ndzi pfune ku basisa Berth 14 nimadyambu lawa, naswona a wu nga ha ta karhateka hi renti eMercury Arcade nakambe."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "U hundzile eka makhamera ya khoto ya magistrate, Sbu. Swi lulamile. Hafu ya Provincial Headquarters va le ka payroll ya Mokoena, hi swona leswi ndzi rhurhiseke ntlawa wa mina wa task force laha hansi ni michini ya 1980s ya microfiche."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "U languteka wo biha, n'wananga—naswona ndzi twile leswaku Constable Nandi u rhatiwe hi riso eka N2. Ndzi byele leswaku u tise nchumu lowu nga ta kota ku lwisana ni jaji ya High Court."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Xikwembu xa mina... 'khoma sedan ya yena eka off-ramp ya Umgeni u hisa briefcase.' I rito ra Titus Mokoena, ri twala kahle."
"Ndzi veka movha wa wena eka rejistri ya hina ya diplomatic ya federal sweswi leswaku ndzi basisa Precinct Heat ya wena. Tshama u ri karhi u hanya ku fikela loko hi hangalasa leswi, Sbu."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Hikuva nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana loko ndzi tsala warrant ehenhla, munhu un'wana eMinisiteri u byela City Hall endzeni ka khume-nhlanu wa timinete. Handle ka ledger ya mali NA mpfumawulo wa Berth 14, muchuchisi u ta cukumeta mhaka leyi a nga si dya swakudya swa mixo."
"Loko hi rhumela phakheji hinkwayo eka The Daily Veld newsroom hi nga si pfalela Nandi eka vuhlayiseki bya timbhoni, a va nge swi koti ku swi fihla."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "Yi teke. Kongomisa ku hlundzuka ka wena eka super-lab ya Zuko ya le Midlands kumbe swigevenga swa Mokoena—siya wansati wa khale eka villa ya yena ya le Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Un'wana ni un'wana wa tipolitiki wa vutlhari eKwaZulu-Natal u tiva leswaku Rand i ya ku tirhisa kasi Dirham i ya ku hlayisa. Sovereign Pearl yi khome ndhawu eDubai, purasi ra switswuri eMidlands, ni xihahampfhuka xa charter eHangar 7."
"Zuko u na makume-mune ntlhanu wa tiphesente, mina ndzi na makume-nharhu, kasi Titus Mokoena u na makume-mbirhi ntlhanu hikwalaho ka ku hlayisa swibamu swi nga hi kongomisi."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "U hacke terminal ya escrow? U ni matimba hakunene. Swi lulamile—vachuchisi lava va khomeke Contempt Warrant ya wena va landzelela ntlawa wa mina. Ndzi ta va byela leswaku va hlwela ku ku khoma."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Moya wu basile la henhla eRidge, a swi tano, Sbu? Ehansi eCBD va khome Judicial Commission of Inquiry ya vona, va endla onge jaji loyi a dyondzeke u ta kota ku lulamisa malembe ya makume-mbirhi ya vukanganyisi bya masipala."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Masutukheyi ya mina se ma le King Shaka Hangar 7. Hikwalaho ka yini u khandziya xitandi xa mina xa xilivhi loko xidzedze xi kusuhi ni ku hela?"
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Hinkwawo ka wona! Exikarhi ka 1:00 AM na 4:00 AM, ematshan'wini yo pompa mati eka reservoir, malori lawa ma khandziye N3 ma ya eka purasi ra switswuri ekusuhi na Howick spur."
"Hlanganisa data yoleyo, Sbu, kutani u ta kuma ndhawu leyi super-lab ya Zuko yi nga eka yona."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Hi leyi flash module ya Tanker #14! Naswona u nga vileli hi swigevenga swa le Joburg—sedan yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi nghenaka eka corridor ya le n'walungu yi ta khomiwa hi makume-mune ya ti-Quantum va nga si kota ku rhwala xibamu."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Languta matanker lawa hi ma khomeke tolo nivusiku, Sbu! Swiphemu swa le ndzeni swi khomeleriwile—a ku na mati, kambe ku na ntsalwa wa chemical precursor eka xiphemu lexi fihliweke."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Vanhu va le n'walungu va karhele ku rindzela ti-commission ta High Court. Vaxavisi va mina va pfalile depot, naswona swigevenga swa Mokoena swa le handle ka xifundzankulu swi le ku laveni ka wena eka tindlela ta le tintshaveni."
dialogue.new_lead_title: Nkambisiso lowuntshwa wa xiyimo kumbe vumbhoni byintshwa byi kona!

dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Hlayisa tinyangwa ta depot, Bra Bheki. Hi ya lwa eka ndhawu ya vona."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Xana matanker lawa ma ha ri na GPS transponders ya wona ya le dash-mount?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "A hi humeseni ti-GPS flash chips eka Lead Tanker #14 sweswi hi veka vanhu va ku langutela swigevenga."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Vachayeli va wena va vusiku va vula yini hi tithankara ta mati?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Intel ya kahle. A hi buleni hi swin'wana."
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Khoma mavoni ya wena ya ri ehansi, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Respect, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Leswi hi swona leswi a swi kayivela exikarhi ka rivala ra swikepe ni xihahampfhuka."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Queen Street alliance yi yimile swin'we. Rank yi nga ndzi pfuna hi mali ya operation?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "Swi ta ya hi kuqoqola convoy ya vona."
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Varindzi va wena va le rank va ndzi kolota hi mhaka ya Berea route truce. Susa ti-plate ta mina eka spotters ya Mokoena."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Ku avanyisiwa ka vanhu vanharhu."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Ndzi na xiyimiso xa vumune, Ma-Sibi. Xava xitulu xa wena eka charge sheet ya mina."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "U nga si khandziya Gulfstream yoleyo, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Sovereign Pearl Holdings i yini, naswona hikwalaho ka yini Gulfstream yi ri karhi yi chela petrolo eHangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Mubaleri wa wena wa mali u rivale ku sula SWIFT mirror ya Dubai eka server ya le xitepisi xa 28."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Hikwalaho ka yini Sub-Station 14 yi tshama yi tima loko Pier 2 yi rhula swilo hi xikarefu xa vusiku?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Clerk wa wena u siyile xiyimiso xa Sub-Station 14 eka fax machine. Ndzi kopiya nkarhi wa ku tima ka gezi eport."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Tsakela air-conditioning loko ya ha ri kona, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Ndzi nkhensa swinene, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Xiyimiso xo olova."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ndzi ta hoxa mali leyi eka nkwama. Hi ta vona hi maphepha-hungu."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Hi ta vona loyi a nga ta famba hi xihahampfhuka."
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Makume mune wa tiphesente wa Zululand Aqua-Logistics i wa trust ya ndyangu wa wena, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Goza ra vutlhari."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Nkarhi wo heta leswi eka tarmac."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Hafu ya ti-sergeant ta wena ta TRT a ti nga ri eka xihahampfhuka xexo, Titus. Ndzi va byele leswaku u va siya leswaku va ta rhwala nandzu eka Komishini."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "Loko u khandziya switepisi swoleswo, Titus, u ta va xigevenga vutomi bya wena hinkwabyo."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ndzi hlola charge sheet ya mani na mani, Brigadier. Xana u chaviwa hi swo karhi eka N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Vusiku byinene, Brigadier. Tihlayise eka ku tima ka gezi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Internal Affairs ePretoria va na khopi ya Docket #409. Tshika ku hlola loku kumbe hi ta hisa hinkwerhu."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "Tarmac yi pfulekile. A hi heteni leswi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Ndzi na mpfumawulo wa wena eka tape loko u lerisa ku dlayiwa ka Umgeni, Titus. Ndzi hakela leswaku ndzi lahla khopi leyi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Hi ta vona leswaku xikweleti xa wena xi tshama nkarhi wo tani hi kwihi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_standdown_back.lab: "Swi tsakisa ku endla bindzu na SAPS command."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Hlayisa mianakanyo yoleyo, Titus."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "N'wi kombe ndlela leyi ku humeleleke ha yona eN2 weighbridge. I mani loyi a kokeleke xibamu?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "A hi tlheleleni eka swihlawulelo swa hina."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Leswi swi ndzi hlayisela tiawara to tala to kambisisa marejistara. Khoma swi tiya."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Languta nkarhi wa weighbridge na mina. Hi tihi ti-plate ta tithankara leti a ti ri 'ghosted'?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Humula, Nandi. Khoma rivanti ri pfariwile loko ndzi ri karhi ndzi tirha eka switarata."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ndzi ta tiyisisa leswaku voice note leyi yi vona ku vonakala."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "Tshamela ehansi. Hi le ku ngheneni eka endgame."
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Ndzi kume shell company. Ma-Sibi na Zuko va na tithankara."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "I yini eka foni ya auditor leyi endlaka leswaku Zuko na Mokoena va chava swinene?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Hoxa Ethiopian espresso eka gas burner naswona u hlola burner phone ya mina ku vona loko ku na SAPS IMSI-catchers."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "Ku chesela ko saseka, Sparks."
dialogue_resp.sparks_exit.label: "Hlayisa Faraday cage yi pfariwile, Sparks."
dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "Swi fika laha swi faneleke kona."
dialogue_resp.sparks_lore_back.label: "Swi kahle ku tiva. A hi hloleni bench."
dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "A hi hlanganiseni JTAG pins endzeni ka Faraday cage emahlweni ka loko baseband yi pings tower."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_dockets.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "A hi tsaleni xikombelo xa xihatla xa ku kaneta ku yimisa ku khomiwa ni ku vitana marekhodo ya escrow ya Ridge."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Hlayisa Komishini yi ri karhi yi tirha, Colonel. Ndzi ya eku hlombeni."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_plan.label: "I yini leswi hi swi lavaka ku yimisa Xihahampfhuka ZS-900 ni ku va herisa hi ku helela?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_ask_hawks.label: "Hikwalaho ka yini Hawks va nga si khoma Mokoena na Ma-Sibi, Colonel?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_audio_back.label: "Inkomu, Colonel."
dialogue_resp.vdm_briefing_back.label: "Swi twisisekile, Colonel."
dialogue_resp.vdm_exit.label: "Hlayisa rivanti ra nsimbi ri pfalekile, Colonel. Se ndzi kusuhi."
dialogue_resp.vdm_motion_back.label: "A hi tirhiseni nkarhi lowu."
dialogue_resp.vdm_politics_back.label: "Kutani hi ta hundza hi le henhla hi ku helela."
dialogue_resp.vdm_present_both.label: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Yingisela fayili leyi ya mpfumawulo, Colonel. Mokoena hi yena a leriseke ku hlaseriwa ka N2."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_exit.label: "Hi ta vonana eka tarmac eHangar 7, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Nomboro yin’wana ni yin’wana ya batch ni ndlela ya tanikara swi kopiwile hi le handle. Yimisa ntlawa wa wena wa izinkabi u tlhela u hakela xibalo xa ku hundza."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_why.label: "U ya eDubai hi Xihahampfhuka ZS-900 nimadyambu lawa. Xana The Architect u chuhile?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_deal_back.label: "Hi ta vona leswi vusiku byi nga ta swi tisa."
dialogue_resp.zuko_exit.label: "Hi ta lulamisa leswi loko convoy ya le xikarhi ka vusiku yi fika, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_manifesto_back.label: "Hi ta endla hlawulo wolowo eHangar 7."
dialogue_resp.zuko_philosophy.label: "U ri karhi u chela chefu eka mati ya township leswaku u rhwala chemical precursors, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_present_manifest.labe: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Container MSCU-908114 yi leyi yi nga na xikombiso. Ndzi nyike xiphemu eka mali ya logistics kumbe Hawks va ta khoma MV Southern Cross."
dialogue_resp.zuko_respect_back.label: "Ku fika vusiku eka Berth 14."
dialogue_resp.zuko_street_spot.label: [STREET >= 2] "Varindzi va crane eka Berth 14 va cince xifti. Se ndzi vonile laha va nga voniki kona ekusuhi ni mavhalvu ya petrolo."
dialogue_resp.zuko_truce_back.label: "Hi ta vonana eka xihahampfhuka."
dialogue_resp.zuko_vision_back.label: "Un'wana ni un'wana loyi a rhangelaka u ehleketa leswaku i mufilosofi."

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: CAMPAIGN COMPLETE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): U ponile ku tima ka gezi, u paluxe xihundla xa Sovereign Pearl, u tlhela u tisa lava nga khomiwiki va eThekwini-Gold eka vululami.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Ro sungula eka malembe ya makume mambirhi, ti-sireni ta rivoni ra wasi a ti nga ha susi traffic ya va-VIP—a ti va khoma hi ti-handcuffs."

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Xitichi xa Maphorisa.

ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the Xiyenge xa Vugevhenga’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Va yivile mati va tlhela va hi xavisela dyandza. Namuntlha hi teke malori, ti-tapi, na akhawunti ya banka."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their Ntlawa wa Vugevhenga protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.

ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: CAMPAIGN COMPLETE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): U hlule mintlawa hinkwayo e-eThekwini-Gold u tlhela u teka xitulu xa mfumo wa le hansi ka ndzhuti.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized Dokiti pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Mifumo a yi wili loko hosi yi khandziya xihahampfhuka. Yi cinca ntsena swisayino eka phepha ra vuhlayiseki."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the Ribuwa ra Swikepe cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.

ending.ending_act2_vanished.hook: RINGETA ACT 2 NAKU: Hetisisa "Trace Sovereign Pearl Trust" (e-The Ridge kumbe Khoto ya Le Henhla) kumbe "Synthesize Super-Lab Telemetry" (e-Northern Township Depot) ku nga si pfala Flight ZS-900!
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original Buku ya Timali and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.

ending.ending_captured.p1: Exhausted, broke, and boxed in by Operation Shanela roadblocks, your trail finally runs out in the rain-swept alleys behind Queen Street. When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.
ending.ending_captured.p2: Brigadier Mokoena doesn’t read you your rights. He pulls Dokiti #409 and the dead auditor’s phone from your coat pocket, checks the seal, and nods to Sergeant Dlamini.
ending.ending_captured.p3: By the time the morning commuters crowd the taxi rank, theMercury Arcade flat has been scrubbed Tengile, and another anonymous dossier has vanished into the furnace of eThekwini-Gold.

ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Dokiti #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.

ending.ending_vigilante.p1: When Stage 6 kills the Ribuwa ra Swikepe floodlights at midnight, Bra Bheki’s minibus convoy cuts its headlights and blocks the Pier 2 weighbridge. Fifteen heavily armed izinkabi step out from behind the rusting container stacks just as Brigadier Mokoena’s unmarked TRT vans escort the municipal water tankers onto Berth 14.
ending.ending_vigilante.p2: The firefight echoes across the Natal Port Channel for twenty minutes. Punctured chemical drums spill across the wet asphalt, catching a tracer round and sending a wall of orange flame forty metres into the humid night sky.
ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer Mali ya Rixaka, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.

ending.ending_whistleblower.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: Loko Mokoena a ri karhi a baleka tanihi nhenha ya vugevenga naswona Nandi a lunghiselela ku nyikela vumbhoni e-High Court, u fanele u hlayisa mbhoni ya wena leyi hlawulekeke yi hanya hi 72 wa tiawara.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Vuhlayiselo bya Matimu Kamara ra le Hansi. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.

event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Mvula ya le ribuweni ya mbilu yi ba eka khonkreti ya Hangar 7. Mimovha ya Rolls-Royce ya Gulfstream ZS-900 yi rila loko vatirhi va forklift va layita mapalete yo hetelela ya mali na mapapila ya vuhosi endzeni.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Eka xisekelo xa switepisi swa xifofane ku yime vaxopaxopi vanharhu va ku khomiwa ka eThekwini-Gold: Zuko Ndlovu a ambale jazi ra yena ro basa, Councillor Ma-Sibi a khome pasipoto ya yena ya vuhosi, na Brigadier Mokoena a kongomise xibamu xa yena eka tarmac leyi tsakameke.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Ntlhanu wa timinete ku suka, Warrant Officer," Zuko u huwelela ehenhla ka ririla ra jeti. "Tiendlele xiboho xa leswaku i tiko ra njhani leri u nga ta pfuka u ri vona mundzuku."

event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.title: Ku suka e-Hangar 7: Ku lulamisiwa ka timhaka

event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p2: "U le ku khomiweni hi xileriso xa ku sivela hikwalaho ka ku va na marekhodo ya municipal infrastructure lama nga riki enawini."

event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p2: Zuko na Brigadier Mokoena va rhume swigevenga swa vona leswi humaka ehandle ka xifundza leswaku va tiyiseka leswaku a wu fiki eka High Court witness stand.

event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Mpfula yi na hi matlhelo eka Natal Port Channel loko ti-gantry cranes ta Pier 2 ti huma eka mungu. Ehansi ka Berth 14, ti-tanker tinharhu ta mati ta masipala ti yime hi ku rhula etlhelo ka ti-container ta Zuko Ndlovu, ti rhendzeriwe hi ti-Nyalas ta TRT ta Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Nkarhi wa wena wu herile. Hambi u fike laha u ri ni ti-ledger leti hlayiweke, ti-voice note ta mu-auditor, kumbe matimba ya le mugarini, u na nkarhi wun'we ntsena wo endla xiboho xa wena emahlweni ka loko convoy yi humela eka N2 highway.

event.evt_climax_berth14.title: Midnight at Berth 14: The Final Play
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p1: Mavoko ya wena ma nga tshiki ku rhurhumela. Exikarhi ka musi wa jenereta ya dizili, ku rila ka ti-sireni eQueen Street, ni tin'hweti ta tsevu u ri karhi u tikambela, mahlo ya wena ma sungula ku va ni mimpfapfarhuto.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: U wela eka xitepisi xa khonkreti ya Mercury Arcade, u karhatekile ku hefemula. Loko u nga tiyisi miehleketo ya wena sweswi, u ta endla xihoxo xa ku fa.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.speaker: Miehleketo ya le Ndzeni
event.evt_composure_breakdown.title: Ku Chava ka Munyama: Ku Wa ka Miehleketo
event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: U andlala maphepha ya ngati ya Docket #409 eka tafula ra wena ehansi ka rivoni. Tinomboro ti sungula ku twisiseka.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" yi rhumele City Hall R400 wa timiliyoni ku yisa mati ya xihatla eka madoroba ya le n'walungwini. Kambe ti-GPS ti komba leswaku ti-tanker ta masipala a ti yanga eka madoroba wolawo—ti fambe hi ku kongoma ku suka e-Pier 2 Cold Storage ti ya eka ti-warehouse ta le handle ka doroba, ti rhangeriwe hi ti-van ta TRT ta Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: Councillor Ma-Sibi a nga yivi mali ya mati ntsena. Ti-tanker ta yena ta masipala ti rhwala swimilana swa tikhemikhali swa ti-lab ta methamphetamine ta Zuko Ndlovu.

event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p1: Musi wo tshwuka wu tlakuka eka xiteshi xa Umgeni hi mixo. Sindikati ya ku yiva koporo yi yive ti-cable tinharhu ta gezi hi vusiku, swi endla leswaku ti-traffic light ta CBD ti va eka xiphithiphithi.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Vahlaleri va Bra Bheki va teke ti-intersection hi ti-whistle na ti-sjambok, loko ti-van ta SAPS ti ri karhi ti pfaleriwe eka traffic ti ri kusuhi.

event.evt_morning_cable_theft.title: Morning Dispatch: Umgeni Feeder Cable yi yiviwile
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p1: Loko tekisi ta mixo ti sungula ku rila eQueen Street, foni ya wena ya burner yi rhurhumela hi mhayeti ya Signal leyi humaka eka Xitepisi xa 4 xa City Hall.
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Hi swi tiva leswaku Constable Nandi u ku tisilele maphepha ya Mandla Sithole. Ku hava munhu eCity Hall la lavaka ku tlhela a va ni mukhosi. Hunguta ku kambela ka wena namuntlha, naswona R800 ya mali ya ku tsundzuxa ya masipala yi ta vekiwa eka bokisi ra wena ra poso hi nkarhi wa awara."

event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.title: Encrypted Wire: Xihlovo xa le Xitepisi xa 4
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: Rito ra mhalamhala ri twala ehenhla ka mungu wa le xibakabakeni loko xikepe xa makontinara xa MV Southern Cross xi hundza eka breakwater. Xiyanimoya xa wena lexi nga ni xihundla xi sungula ku rila hi rito ra Colonel van der Merwe.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Yingisani kahle. Mabodela ya tikhemikhali ya Zuko Ndlovu ma ta rhurhiwa eBerth 14 nivusiku lebyi, naswona ti-van ta TRT ta Mokoena ti le ku lunghekeni eka weighbridge. Tiyiseka leswaku u khome Decoded Tanker Ledger kumbe Berth 14 Manifest mahlweni ka loko nkarhi wu ba khume-mbirhi."

event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.title: Mahungu ya xihatla: MV Southern Cross yi nghena eBerth 14
event.evt_nandi_critical.p1: Nandi u rhurhumela ngamandla ehansi ka bulangeti lebyi tateke hi swi-juluta. Xilondzo xa xibamu lexi tsemeke eka mbabala ya yena xi hundzuke xitshopana xo biha, naswona u sungula ku lahlekeriwa hi mianakanyo.
event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: Loko u n'wi yisa e-Addington kumbe e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospital, rejistara ya swilondzo swa xibamu yi ta tivisa Brigadier Mokoena endzeni ka timinete ta makume mambirhi.

event.evt_nandi_critical.title: Septic Shock
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p1: Sparks u humesa musi wa vape loko foni ya mu-auditor loyi a feke yi pfula hi ku hetelela. Endzeni ka foldara ya xihundla ku na mpfumelelo wa mpfumawulo na manifesta ya swilo swa vusiku bya namuntlha.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: Eka mpfumawulo, rito ra Brigadier Mokoena ri twala kahle: "Susa swihinga swa N2 hi xikari ka vusiku. Container ya Zuko yi ta fika e-Berth 14, naswona un'wana na un'wana wa Hawks loyi a lavaka ku tiva u ta lahliwa eka mugodi."

event.evt_phone_decrypted.title: Voice Note from Berth 14
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p1: Mahlundlu ya maphorisa ma twala exikarhi ka miako leyi tlakukeke. Swivoni swa le henhla na swikongomiso swa xilamula swi pfala tindlela hinkwato ta CBD loko SAPS na Metro Police va veka ndhawu yo kambela hi matimba.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p2: Kombhi yin'wana na yin'wana, xithuthuthu xa ku rhwala swilo, na munhu un'wana na un'wana va le ku kambeleni swibamu leswi nga riki na mpfumelelo na ti-docket leti yiviweke.

event.evt_shanela_roadblock.title: Operation Shanela Lockdown
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p1: Maphoto ya nyimpi ma rila eka xitepisi xa Mercury Arcade. Hi le ka swifasiteri, ti-Volkswagen Golf GTI tinharhu leti nga riki na swikombiso na Nyala ya nyimpi swi pfalela matlhelo mambirhi ya xitarata.
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p2: Xibamu xi ba xigwitsirisi xa wena xa nsimbi. "Hawks Warrant Officer! Pfula nyangwa kumbe hi ta yi fayela! Brigadier Mokoena u lava docket yakwe!"

intro.pitch: Eka tin'hweti ta tsevu leti hundzeke, Brigadier Titus Mokoena u ku hembile a tlhela a lahla baji ya wena ya Hawks. Vusiku byebyi, hi nkarhi wa ku tsemiwa ka gezi ka Stage 4 eribuweni, loyi a a ri munghana wa wena lontshwa u tsutsumela efuletini ya wena ya Mercury Arcade a ri karhi a halaka ngati hi xilondza xa xibalesa—a tamele buku leyi nga tala ngati leyi hlanganisaka tithendara ta tilori ta mati ta R400m ta City Hall hi ku kongoma na cartel ya swidzidzirisi ya Abasanta.
intro.pitch_story2: Ku onhiwa ka maano ka ku humesiwa ka gezi ra Eskom ku sindzisa tithendara ta dizili ta xihatla, leti seketeriwaka hi van’wamabindzu va vuhlayiseki na va-minista va vukungundzwana. Mulavisisi wa SIU Kagiso "Bra K" Molefe u fanele ku nghena emikotini yo enta ya migodi ya Johannesburg na tindlu ta Sandton gezi ri nga si wa.
intro.pitch_story3: Timbuyelo leti nga tsarisiwangiki to cela tidayimani ehansi ka lwandle, ku yisiwa ka matlhari eka mindzilikano, na masocha ya le matini ya phurayivhete lama hlantswaka mali ya matimba ma va maribye ya timholovo ta matiko hinkwawo eribuweni ra Atlantic leri funengetiwaka hi hunguva ePort Nolloth na Richtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: Nhlangano ya xihundla ya ti-general ta maphorisa ya xifundzha, mintlawa leyi hlanganeke ya vugevenga bya Cape Flats, na van’wamabindzu va vhinyo va ndhavuko lava hlomisaka vuthu ra vuhlayiseki ra phurayivhete ku lawula ikhonomi ya vusiku na madoko yo rhumela handle. Mutektivhe wa khale wa Yuniti yo Lwisana na Mintlawa Leila Hendricks u lavisisa ku suka eCamps Bay ku fika etindlwini ta vhinyo ta Stellenbosch.
intro.pitch_story5: Ku Wa Hi ku Hetiseka ka Gezi ra Xiteji xa 8 eka swifundzha hinkwaswo swa kaye. Ntlawa lowu Hlanganeke wa Hawks wu hlanganisa matsalwa ya mune ya nkoka ya swifundzha ku hlasela nhlengeletano ya xiyimo xa le henhla ya Sovereign Octagon eDrakensberg temokrasi yi nga si herisiwa hi ku helela.

mission.classified_exhibits_header: Vumbhoni byo Hlayiseka na Switirhisiwa swa Makete wa Ntima:
mission.faq_q1_body: Cycle i Siku ri 1 eNtlhangwini (shift ya tiawara ta 24). A ku na mpimo wo karhi wo fana na masiku ya 50 kumbe 100. Ematshan'wini ya sweswo, u tsutsuma hi ku lwisana na Tiwachi ta Tinhlaselo leti Fambaka (to fana na ku phasa ka Mokoena eka swiyenge swa 6). Vulavisisi byo toloveleka byi teka ticycle ta 3 ku ya eka 6 eka Act 1 na ta 4 ku ya eka 8 eka Act 2.
mission.faq_q1_title: 1. "Cycle" i yini naswona ku na mangani?
mission.faq_q2_body: Mixo wun'wana na wun'wana, u hoxa tidayisi ta 3 ku ya eka 5 HIKWATO ka doroba hinkwaro hi ku ya hi ku Tiyisela ka wena (80%+ = tidayisi ta 5, 40–79% = tidayisi ta 4, <40% = tidayisi ta 3). A WU hoxi tidayisi eka ndhawu yin'wana na yin'wana! U hlawula swiendlo swa nkoka swa 3 ku ya eka 5 eka mepe ku tirhisa matshalatshala ya wena ya siku.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Ndzi kuma tidayisi tingani? Xana ndzi hoxa tidayisi eka ndhawu yin'wana na yin'wana?
mission.faq_q3_body:
Ku kandziya Hetisa Cycle swi hetisa shift ya wena swi tlhela swi ku yisa eka mixo lowu landzelaka:
• Tiwachi ta Tinhlaselo ti ya emahlweni (+1 xiyenge eka tiwachi to tshuka).
• Ku tsemiwa ka gezi ka cincana (Stage 2 → 4 → 6 → 2).
• Rungula ro Tsariwa ra Mixo ri fika ri ri na switsundzuxo swintshwa swa ntiyiso.
• U hoxa tidayisi tintshwa mixo wa mundzuku.
mission.faq_q3_title: 3. Ku humelela yini loko ndzi kandziya "Hetisa Cycle / Etlela"?
mission.faq_q4_body: Xitulu xa le hansi xi kombisa "X leyi nga kona • Y leyi tirhisiweke". Tidayisi leti tirhisiweke ti hundzuka dzwii hi muvala wo dzwihala ti tlhela ti kombisa [TI TIRHISIWILE]. Tidayisi leti nga kona i ti-block leti voningaka ti ri na tinhlayo ta nsuku kumbe tinomboro.
mission.faq_q4_title: 4. Ndzi swi tivisa ku yini leswaku hi tihi tidayisi leti tirhisiweke na leti nga kona?
mission.faq_q5_body: Ina! Loko ku hlota ka Brigadier Mokoena ku fika eka 6/6, kamara ra wena ri hlaseriwa kutani vulavisisi byi hela hi ku khomiwa. Loko ku halaka ngati ka Constable Nandi ku fika eka 4/4 u nga si n'wi pfuneta, wa fa ehandle ko tlhela a pfuka eka fulete ya wena (-30% ku Tiyisela). Loko ku Tiyisela ka wena ku fika eka 0%, u sungula Blackout Paranoia!
mission.faq_q5_title: 5. Xana munhu wa mina a nga fa kumbe ku vanga Game Over?

pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Hi awara ya mambirhi nimixo, gezi ra masipala ri fa hi mpfumawulo wa nsimbi e-substation ya le Queen Street. Fan ya le henhla yi yima. Ehandle ka mafasitere ya wena, mpfula ya le ribuweni yi ba ti-tin ta Mercury Arcade, leyi voningiwaka ntsena hi rivoni ra jenereta ya dizili ya spaza shop leyi nga le tlhelo.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Etafuleni ra wena ku na botlhe ya byala leyi saleke hafu na papila ra ku yimisiwa ntirho leri sayiniweke hi Brigadier Titus Mokoena tin'hweti ta tsevu leti hundzeke.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Kutani ku twakala mpfumawulo—a hi wa le hansi, kambe i ku ba kanharhu hi matimba eka gete ra wena ra nsimbi ya Trellidor le henhla ka fire escape. U nga si khumba 9mm Parabellum leyi nga ehansi ka matiresi ya wena, tsundzuka leswaku a wu ri mani u nga si va Mokoena a nga si fihla ntirho wa wena:
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: U lungisa Z88 ya wena u tlhela u yima etlhelo ka nyangwa. Hi xiphephu xa le nyangweni, rivoni ra xihundla ri voninga windbreaker ya SAPS leyi tsakameke.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: I Constable Nandi—rookie un'we ntsena loyi a alaka ku sayina affidavit ya mavunwa ya Mokoena hi wena. U khome mbabvu ya yena ya ximatsini, ngati ya ntima yi huma eka tintiho ta yena, a khome dokele ra manila na smartphone leyi fayekeke ehansi ka voko ra yena.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." u hefemula, mahlo ya yena ma languta endzhaku. "Pfula gete. Ndza kombela. Ti-van ta Mokoena ta TRT ti hundze hi le taxi rank. Loko radio ya mina ya ha tirha, va le ndzhaku ka mina hi ti-block timbirhi."
pnode.scene_2_the_door.role: SAPS Maphorisa ya Xitimela xa Rivengo ni Patu Leyikulu (Loyi a a ri Mutirhi wa Wena wa Khale)
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: U sindzisa thawula leyi baseke eka mbabvu ya yena. Xibamu xa 9mm xi n'wi khumbile katsongo—xi entile ku humesa ngati, kambe xi ni khombo ku xi thunga e-xibedlele xa mfumo laha maphorisa ma tsariaka hinkwavo lava nga thuntshiwa.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: Nandi u ku nyika Docket #409 na smartphone leyi nga na ngati. "Hi hlamule ku yiviwa ka Cash-in-Transit e-N2 south ramp hi xikare-kare. Van ya G4S yi fayeteriwe hi C4, Warrant. Kambe a ku nga ri na mali endzeni."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: U mita mate, a ri karhi a rhurhumela. "A ku na mu-audit wa masipala loyi a a bohiwe hi ti-handcuffs, na ledger leyi. Mune wa madzana ya timiliyoni ta ti-Rand eka ti-tender ta ti-tanker ta mati leti hundzeke hi le ofisini ya Councillor Ma-Sibi ku ya eka ti-warehouse ta Zuko Ndlovu. Loko munghana wa mina a ringeta ku swi tsala, Brigadier Mokoena u fikile hi bakkie ya TRT... a n'wi thuntsha exifuveni."
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: Nandi u etlela eka sofa ya wena loko ku voninga ka mixa ku sungula ku humelela eka mafasitere. Ehandle, mimovha ya tekisi yi sungula ku rila eQueen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: U na swiphiqo swimbirhi leswi nga ta ku hlasela: xilondzo xa Nandi xa xibamu xi ta bola endzhaku ka mune wa masiku handle ko hakela dokodela wa le hansi ka tafula (R1,500), naswona ntlawa wa TRT wa Brigadier Mokoena wu ri karhi wu kambisisa ndhawu hinkwayo.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Emavokweni ya wena ku na vumbhoni lebyi hlanganisaka City Hall, SAPS Organized Crime, na Abasanta Cartel. Diki ra wena ra siku ri lunghekile eka tafula.

tutorial.step1.badge: XITEJI XA 1 EKA 6 // BARA YA LE HANSI NA MUTSHINXI
tutorial.step1.bullet1: Tshindzela dayisi rin’wana na rin’wana eka tireyi ya le hansi ku ri khoma—Xikhala xin’wana na xin’wana xa Xiendlo xi komba ntsengo lowu cinciweke (Rihlaza 6+, Xitshopana 4–5, Tshwuka 1–3).
tutorial.step1.bullet2: A wu tiyiseki hi leswi u faneleke ku swi endla? Landzelela "Mutshinxi wa Maqhinga" eka Panel ya Ximatsi kumbe u lavisisa mimfungho ya "★ Ringanyetiwile".
tutorial.step1.bullet3: Loko tiherile tidayisi ta siku, tshindzela "Hlanganisa Xirhendzevutana / Etlela →" ku ya mahlweni na mixo lowu taka.
tutorial.step1.desc: Hi mixo wa Nkarhi wun'wana na wun'wana (Siku), mufundzi wa wena u hoxa madayisi ya 3 ku ya eka 5 ya matlhelo ya tsevu hi ku ya hi Ku Tikhoma ka sweswi (80–100% = madayisi ya 5, 40–79% = madayisi ya 4, <40% = madayisi ya 3). Ku Tikhoma i matimba ya wena ya miehleketo na vuswikoti bya ku tiyisela eka misava ya le hansi ya Durban.
tutorial.step1.title: Goza 1: Madayisi Ya Mintirho Ya Siku Na Siku & Ku Tikhoma
tutorial.step1.zone: Tidayisi ta Swiendlo swa Siku na Siku, Ku Rhula na Mutshinxi wa Maqhinga
tutorial.step2.badge: XITEJI XA 2 EKA 6 // DROWARA YA LE XINENE
tutorial.step2.bullet1: Ku Rika ko Hetelela = Xikandza xa Dayisi + Xincinci xa Xiyimo + Bonasi ya Xiteji 6 + Switirho.
tutorial.step2.bullet2: 6 kumbe ku tlula (Rihlaza — Ku Hlula loku Baseke): Yisa emahlweni Tiwatxi ta Vulavisisi hi swiyenge swa +2 kumbe ku hakela ti-Rand.
tutorial.step2.bullet3: 4 kumbe 5 (Xitshopana — Ku Hlula loku nga le Khombyeni): Yisa emahlweni xiphemu xa +1 kambe swi dya Ku Rhula kutsongo.
tutorial.step2.bullet4: 1 ku fika eka 3 (Tshwuka — Tsandzeka / Blowback): Ku hava nhluvuko, ku lahlekeriwa hi Ku Rhula, naswona swi engetela ku Hisa ka Maphorisa.
tutorial.step2.desc: Khoma kumbe tlakula dayisi eka doki ya wena ya le hansi, kutani tlakula Xihlayiselo Xa Mintirho eka ndhawu yin'wana na yin'wana ya mepe leyi pfuliweke. Ku hoxa ku hetiseka hi ndlela leyi tiyeke: Ntsengo Wa Dayisi + Xichayachaya Xa Stat + Xichayachaya Xa Ku Tima Ka Gezi Xa Xiteji Xa 6 + Xihlawulelo Xa Ndhawu Ya Valala. Swiyimo swi kombisa kahle: 6+ Ku Humesa Loku Hlwitekeke, 4–5 Ku Komprometiwa, 1–3 Ku Tsandzeka.
tutorial.step2.title: Goza 2: Ku Nyika Madayisi Eka Swihlayiselo Swa Mintirho
tutorial.step2.zone: Swikhala swa Swiendlo swa Node na Swincinci swa Xiyimo
tutorial.step3.badge: XITEJI XA 3 EKA 6 // IKHONOMI NA MATIMBA
tutorial.step3.bullet1: Xitolo xa Switirho swa le Xihundleni (ehenhla ka HUD): Xava mpfuxeto wa nkarhi hinkwawo e-Golden Dragon kumbe Point Road (+1 WAYA, +1 XITARATA).
tutorial.step3.bullet2: Swirhambelo swa Maqhinga swa Mintlawa (1/hi Siku): Fikelela +1/+2 Rep na ntlawa ku pfulela vuswikoti bya mahala bya siku na siku.
tutorial.step3.bullet3: Ku Holisiwa ka le Tindlwini to Sirheleleka: Tirhisa ti-Rand eka ku Holisa Vuvabyi (+25% Ku Rhula), Makungu ya Shebeen, Dizili (R300), na Vufukuzani (R200).
tutorial.step3.desc: Matimba ya Eskom ma cinca eka Switeji 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 vusiku byin'wana na byin'wana. Hi nkarhi wa Ku Tima Ka Gezi Ka Xiteji Xa 6, swihlayiselo swa server swa thekinoloji ya le henhla swa pfaleka handle ka loko u tirhisa R300 eka Diesel Ya Jenereyitara Ya Xihlovo, kambe mintirho ya le xihundleni eka Port na Estates yi kuma +2 Roll Bonus ehansi ka xisirhelelo xa munyama.
tutorial.step3.title: Goza 3: Ku Tima Ka Gezi Loku Cincaka (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.zone: Ti-Rand (ZAR), Xitolo xa Switirho na Mipfuno ya Mintlawa
tutorial.step4.badge: XITEJI XA 4 EKA 6 // TIKHOMBO NA KU SIVELERIWA
tutorial.step4.bullet1: Ku Hluriwa / Ku Khomiwa (Ntlangu wu Herile): Loko nhlaselo wa Brigadier Mokoena wu fika eka 6/6, yindlu yo sirheleleka ya hlaseriwa ivi u khomiwa.
tutorial.step4.bullet2: Ku Lahlekeriwa hi Munhu (Phorisa Nandi): Loko ku huma ngati ka Nandi ku fika eka 4/4 u nga si n’wi tshungula, Phorisa Nandi u fela rindi emutini wa wena (-30% Ku Rhula).
tutorial.step4.bullet3: Ku Tsandzeka ka Ku Rhula (0% Ku Rhula): Ku fika eka 0% swi vanga xiyimo xa xilamulela-mhangu lexi dyaka Dayisi ri-1 mundzuku. Ku hunguta Rep ya ntlawa ku ya eka -2 swi vanga ku lwisana hi swibalesa.
tutorial.step4.desc: Circular segmented clocks tick down impending catastrophes (Brigadier Mokoena's Tsima ro Hlantswa, Nandi's Mbhondzo, Izinkabi Hit Squads) and track your forensic breakthroughs (Dokiti #409 Nxopaxopo wa Timali, Phone Cracking, Berth 14 Convoy). When investigation clocks fill, climactic finale showdowns unlock.
tutorial.step4.title: Goza 4: Tiwachi Ta Xihoxo & Ta Vufundzi
tutorial.step4.zone: Tiwatxi ta Ntlhontlho, Ku Rhula na Makumu ya Munhu
tutorial.step5.badge: XITEJI XA 5 EKA 6 // LE HENHLA KA HUD NA MAVHU
tutorial.step5.bullet1: Ku Pfariwa ka Xiteji 6: Ti-server ta City Hall na Golden Dragon ta tima hi nkarhi wa Xiteji 6—handle ka loko u hakela R300 ya dizili.
tutorial.step5.bullet2: Bonasi ya Nsirhelelo ya Xiteji 6: Ku nghena Pier 2 Cold Storage swi kuma Bonasi ya +2 hi nkarhi wa Xiteji 6 hikuva timboni ta hlaluko ta tima.
tutorial.step5.bullet3: Swivandla swa SAPS swo Pfala: Loko ku Hisa ku fika eka 4+, tindledlana ta doroba ta pfariwa, swi koxa R200 kumbe Dayisi ri-1 ku pela handle ka loko u ri na SAPS Radio Scanner.
tutorial.step5.desc: High Xitichi xa Maphorisa Heat or Threat levels trigger armed SAPS roadblock corridors between sectors. Crossing them burns 1 Die or R200 in cold drink bribes unless you possess a cloned SAPS scanner. Earn positive Faction Rep to unlock 1/day tactical abilities like Grid Manipulation and Blue-Light Escorts.
tutorial.step5.title: Step 5: Roadblocks & Faction Perks
tutorial.step5.zone: Kutsemiwa ka Gezi na Swivandla swo Pfala swa Maphorisa
tutorial.step6.badge: XITEJI XA 6 EKA 6 // PFHUMBA NA KU TLHELA U TLANGISISA
tutorial.step6.bullet1: Ku Hlula Xiendlo 1 na ku Nghena eka Xiendlo 2: Kuma mintlhontlho mimbirhi ya nkoka ku sungula Berth 14 Finale, ivi u tshindzela "Yana emahlweni eka Xiendlo 2: The Bluff Refinery →".
tutorial.step6.bullet2: Ku Hlula Xiendlo 2: Tlhantlha mavito ya phayiphi ya Island View na ku kambisisa ka petrochemical ku sungula Ndzivalelo ya Phalamende.
tutorial.step6.bullet3: Ntlangu Wuntshwa+ na Rhejistara ya Fixer: Endzhaku ka ku hlula, languta Xiyimo xa wena xa Fixer eka Rhejistara ya eThekwini, hlengeleta Mimfungho ya 6, ivi u sungula Ntlangu Wuntshwa+ ku hlayisa switirho hinkwaswo + R1,000!
tutorial.step6.desc: Speak with local fixers and faction bosses at each node to interrogate leads, present forensic exhibits, and claim one-time favors. Press 'B' or tap 'BOARD' anytime to inspect your red-string conspiracy corkboard, tracing the money trail from City Hall to Berth 14.
tutorial.step6.title: Step 6: Contacts, Evidence & Red-String Board
tutorial.step6.zone: Xiendlo 1 → Xiendlo 2, Vuhlayiselo bya Makumu na Ntlangu Wuntshwa+
